Native fortress world Reports list: source-level reconstruction
==============================================================

Source: installed native Windows 53.16 Steam and official/classic PE images
selected by data/runtime/native-pe-images.json. native-images.json records the
actual image identities. All coordinates below are reference-image RVAs; every
paired classic body is archived alongside it. The source blocks were decoded
from those PE files with the fixed native objdump. This file describes original
code and text production, not a test or an observed translated game result.

List boundary and record identity
--------------------------------
The world-screen report-list path is 1d0b2d..1d0f47, classic 1d0abd..1d0ed7.
It concatenates two index collections, screen+8330 and screen+8348. The former
indexes mission reports in global24e3908; the latter indexes spoils/tribute
records in global24e3920. The three caption families are produced elsewhere and
retained in record storage. The consumer does not translate or regenerate them.

if index < mission_indices.size():
    mission_record = mission_reports[mission_indices[index]]
else:
    loot_record = loot_reports[loot_indices[index - mission_indices.size()]]

if mission_record:
    bright = !(mission_record.flags_at_48 & 1)
    source = mission_record.string_at_28
else if loot_record:
    bright = !(loot_record.flags_at_20 & 1)
    source = loot_record.string_at_0
else:
    no caption submitted for this row

set_color(6, 0, bright)
addst(source, width=screen_width-3)  // 1d0db2; classic1d0d42

If both index collections are empty: create "No reports available", set
color(6,0,true), draw it at 1d0f35 (classic1d0ec5). There is no fourth title
family or native special caption for the unread/read flag. This branch is
separate from an invalid/null record slot in a nonempty collection.

The three dots written at 1d0dee/1d0e02/1d0e16 target a local temporary string;
the stored source above is the actual preceding title draw's argument. The
temporary is also drawn at 1d0e2d. These bytes do not introduce another title
grammar. Drawing and viewport/scrollbar branches are retained in the asm.

The complete native Report: prefix reference set in each PE also contains
"Interrogation Report: ". Its separate producer2bc250 (classic2b9e10) stores
records via global24e3938 at2bc3ee, whereas this list consumes only globals
24e3908 and24e3920. The producer's storage boundary is archived separately to
record why that fourth native prefix does not appear in this list. The full
Report: reference set is retained as report-prefix-source rows in the catalogue.

Mission Report title
--------------------
Owner9df530; title block9df8bd..9dfbba; classic owner9dcd60 and block9dd0ed..
9dd3ea. army+60 is the mission object, goal is its DWORD+138 (leaf75110 reads
it directly), target site ID is mission+8, subtype data pointer is mission+130.
Existing mission+128 report storage suppresses re-creation of this title. Other
movement/eligibility gates preceding the block are not text producers.

title = "Mission Report: "
switch mission.goal:
    case 2:
        switch *(int32*)mission.subtype_data:
            case 0: title += "Raze "; break
            case 1: title += "Take over "; break
            case 2: title += "Seize "; break
            case 3: title += "Demand tribute from "; break
            case 4: title += "Raid "; break
            case 5: title += "Explore "; break
            case 6: title += "Pillage "; break
            default: title += "Raid "; break
        title += SiteName(mission.site_id, flags=0) // b93930
        break
    case 17:
        title += "Recover "
        title += ArtifactName(*(int32*)mission.subtype_data, flags=0) // b94400
        break
    case 18:
        title += "Rescue "
        context = native_default_event_context() // 72080, flags0
        title += HistoricalFigureName(*(int32*)mission.subtype_data,
                                      context, 1, 1) // b92f10
        break
    case 19:
        title += "Request workers from "
        title += SiteName(mission.site_id, flags=0)
        break
    case 25:
        title += DiplomaticProposalTitle(mission.subtype_data) // 1bb400
        title += " at "
        title += SiteName(mission.site_id, flags=0)
        break
    default:
        // Original native code emits no action or target.
        break
title += " (Set out "
title += CurrentSeasonOrEmpty()
title += " " + signed_decimal(current_year) + ")"
mission_report.string_at_28 = title
mission_report.year_at_4c = current_year
mission_report.tick_at_50 = current_year_tick
mission.report_at_128 = mission_report

Raid table9e36cc (classic9e0efc) was read as all seven uint32 RVAs. The source
table and every branch destination are recorded in native-source-edges.tsv.

DiplomaticProposalTitle (full stackless helper1bb400..1bb568; classic1bb390..
1bb4f8) repeatedly searches a vector of int16 clauses. These tests have
priority, so a proposal containing multiple recognized clauses chooses the
first matching line below, regardless of their position in the vector:

if clauses.contains(10): return "Demand surrender"
if clauses.contains(1):  return "Make peace"
if clauses.contains(13): return "Declare war"
if clauses.contains(14): return "Seek alliance"
if clauses.contains(15): return "Make contact"
if clauses.contains(16): return "Improve trade"
return "Diplomacy"

Spoils Report title and the squad-name source
--------------------------------------------
Owner10b150; title block10f966..10fb02; classic owner10b0e0 and block10f8f6..
10fa92. A native loot/return predicate (r13b) controls creation; raw conditions
are preserved. The caption-producing branch itself is fully included here.

title = "Spoils Report: "
if participating_squads.size() != 0:
    // Direct source pointer: first squad +8, not the alias string at +80.
    name = EnglishName(&participating_squads[0].language_name_at_8,
                       capitalize=true, shorten=false) // call10fa07 -> a946e0
    title += name
    if participating_squads.size() >= 2:
        title += " and others"
    title += ", "
title += CurrentSeasonOrEmpty()
title += " " + signed_decimal(current_year)
loot_report.string_at_0 = title
loot_report.year_at_24 = current_year
loot_report.tick_at_28 = current_year_tick
loot_report.flags_at_20 |= 2
loot_reports.push_back(loot_report)

The vector is filled after the actual lookup75500 of army.squad_id(+1f0)
in global24e37c0, followed by squad+1c4 ownership comparison and call13cac0.
The helper13cac0 keeps squad pointers sorted by squad.id(+0), suppresses
duplicate IDs, and inserts the actual squad pointer. The first displayed
language name therefore belongs to the first participating squad in that
sorted vector. It is not a name inferred from screenshot spelling.

No read of squad.alias(+80) exists in this title path. In contrast, the separate
return announcement in the same producer explicitly tests the alias and uses
it when nonempty (existing fortress-arrivals source extraction). Sharing an
owner function does not make that announcement's alias branch a title branch.
The full language-name helpera946e0..a94ea2 (classic a91760..a91f22) is included.
It reads has_name(+72), first_name(+0), nickname(+20), words(+40), parts of
speech(+5c), and native name-display preferences. The containing name structure
also carries language(+6c) and name type(+70), but this English-form producer
does not use them to select a different spelling. Its two bool arguments control
capitalization and shortening; English WORD-form lookup is inherent to the
function, rather than selected by either bool.
Thus authored components inside language_name also retain their existing native
name rules. The squad alias remains unchanged wherever its own producer uses
it. A title retained in an old record must not be reclassified using the current
alias, a substring heuristic, or an English-versus-Chinese spelling heuristic.

Complete reachable EnglishName field grammar for these title calls
------------------------------------------------------------------
All title call sites pass capitalize=true, shorten=false, directly or through
their typed name supplier. The full general helper is archived, but the
shorten=true suppression branches are not taken by these title calls. It uses
the following native state, with all fields independently empty or absent:

if name.has_name_at_72 == 0:
    return without changing the supplied output // a94723..a94727
    // These title suppliers initialize their temporary output to empty.
clear output // a94747
mode = 0
if unsigned(current_game_type) <= 10:
    mode = nickname_display[current_game_type] // a94730..a94743
// Native modes:0 REPLACE_FIRST,1 CENTRALIZE,2 REPLACE_ALL.
// Any game_type outside0..10 retains mode0. Any other stored mode ignores
// nickname and uses first_name, then continues to generated components.

quote(nickname) = byte0x60 + nickname + byte0x27
// These inline bytes are backtick and apostrophe, not two apostrophes.
// Nickname bytes themselves are appended unchanged, without titlecase.
if nickname is nonempty and mode in {0,2}:
    output = quote(nickname) // a94770..a947a9
else:
    output = NativeTitlecase(first_name) // a947ae..a94879
if nickname is nonempty and mode == 1:
    if output is nonempty: output += " "
    output += quote(nickname) // a94893..a948e0
if nickname is nonempty and mode == 2:
    return // a948e2..a948ed
// Empty nickname:0/1/2/other all use the first_name branch and continue.
// Empty first_name emits nothing; no unknown-name literal is substituted.

W(slot) = EnglishWordForm(name.words[slot], name.parts_of_speech[slot])
C(text) = NativeTitlecase(text) // 52d3c0, rather than only first-byte uppercase
add_spaced(text):
    if output is nonempty: output += " "
    output += text

FrontCompound = words[0](+40), RearCompound = words[1](+44)
FirstAdjective = words[2](+48), SecondAdjective = words[3](+4c)
HyphenCompound = words[4](+50), TheX = words[5](+54), OfX = words[6](+58)
The seven corresponding int16 POS fields start at+5c and end at+68.

if FrontCompound != -1 or RearCompound != -1: // a948f3..a9490b
    compound = W(0) + W(1) // a94934,a94948; no internal delimiter
    if compound is nonempty: add_spaced(C(compound)) // a9494d..a94995

if TheX != -1 or FirstAdjective != -1 or SecondAdjective != -1:
    // Exact gate a949d5..a949e5: lone HyphenCompound is hidden if all three
    // gate IDs are -1. The gate tests IDs, not whether their forms are empty.
    article_added = false
    previous_component_needs_space = output is nonempty
    for slot in {2,3,4,5}: // a94a21,a94ad8,a94b80,a94d05
        part = W(slot)
        if part is empty: continue
        if previous_component_needs_space: output += " "
        if not article_added:
            output += "The " if output is empty else "the "
            article_added = true
        output += C(part)
        if slot == 4:
            output += byte0x2d // a94c79: '-'
            previous_component_needs_space = false
        else:
            previous_component_needs_space = true
    // A visible HyphenCompound and empty/missing TheX leave a trailing '-'.
    // An empty intermediate form neither inserts a delimiter nor a second
    // article; the first nonempty title form owns the article.

if OfX != -1: // a94db2..a94dc6
    part = W(6)
    if part is nonempty:
        if output is nonempty: output += " "
        output += "Of " if output is empty else "of " // a94e18..a94e38
        output += C(part)
// A has_name=true record can still produce an empty string when the literal
// first_name/nickname and all reachable generated forms contribute nothing.

EnglishWordForm is the stackless native leafd2cb50..d2cc1c (classicd29b90..
d29c5c), already completely extracted with its selector table in
data/extracted/unit-preferences/native-decompiled.txt. Negative WORD ID,
WORD ID >= language.words.size(), or unsigned POS >8 contributes no bytes.
The nine selectors use these language_word field offsets:
0 Noun+20;1 NounPlural+40;2 Adjective+60;3 Prefix+80;4 Verb+a0;
5 Verb3rdPerson+c0;6 VerbPast+e0;7 VerbPassive+100;8 VerbGerund+120.
The whole string at that field is appended, including any spaces or punctuation
within the RAW/modded form. Empty valid form also contributes no bytes.

Finite name delimiters are therefore exactly structural spaces, opening
backtick0x60, closing apostrophe0x27, hyphen0x2d, "The ", "the ", "Of " and
"of ". Their bytes/addresses are separately catalogued in native-productions.
RAW form contents, first_name and authored nickname are dynamic field text.
In mode2 the quoted standalone nickname is wholly authored: preserve its inner
bytes; translate the surrounding report heading, participant suffix and date.
In modes0/1 only the generated WORD groups use generated-name translation;
an authored nickname must not be classified as squad.alias or translated from
its English spelling. No mode licenses changing squad.alias(+80).

Tribute Report title
--------------------
Ownera092c0; blocka09633..a09822; classic ownera06af0 and blocka06e63..a07052.

title = "Tribute Report: "
title += EntityName(tribute_record.entity_id_at_0c, flags=0) // a09757 -> b92900
title += ", "
title += CurrentSeasonOrEmpty()
title += " " + signed_decimal(current_year)
loot_report.string_at_0 = title
loot_report.year_at_24 = current_year
loot_report.tick_at_28 = current_year_tick
loot_reports.push_back(loot_report)

There is no squad-count or "and others" branch for tribute. Its name resolves
an actual historical entity, whose language_name is entity+20. Missing entity
is the native text "an unknown civilization" (b92a4c). Flag0 excludes the
LPAGE wrappers present in this general-purpose helper.

Shared season/year finite branches
----------------------------------
CurrentSeasonOrEmpty reads the signed byte at global18d6f0e (classic18d0dfd).
The direct predicates are identical in each title producer:
    0 -> "Spring"
    1 -> "Summer"
    2 -> "Autumn"
    3 -> "Winter"
    every other value -> empty string
All three always append the following space and signed decimal year. They
therefore have a native default branch containing the year without a season.
Year is global23746f4, classic236e604; decimal helper52c130, classic529cf0.
52c130 delegates to52c2b0, which constructs a native string stream, inserts the
original ECX int32 through MSVCP140.dll basic_ostream::operator<<(int), then
returns/joins its stream string. The actual signed-int imported symbol is
??6?$basic_ostream@DU?$char_traits@D@std@@@std@@QEAAAEAV01@H@Z, IAT15e5460,
call52c2e6. The entire year-decimal-core is retained for both editions.
It is a runtime int32 field, not a finite literal to enumerate per savegame.

Typed object-name boundaries and fallbacks
-----------------------------------------
The complete field-supplier bodies are archived for both editions. Their
general-purpose flags/context branches are preserved in native-source-edges;
the following list records the title call site's actual arguments.

SiteName b93930, flags0: site lookup7db20; site.language_name at site+0;
EnglishName(capitalize=true, shorten=false). Missing site -> "an unknown site".

EntityName b92900, flags0: entity lookupba0a0 in global23d17f8; entity.name+20;
EnglishName(capitalize=true, shorten=false). Missing -> "an unknown civilization".

ArtifactName b94400, flags0: binary search global23e6180..23e6188 by artifact.id;
artifact.language_name+8 and item pointer+90. Nonempty native name wins. Empty
name uses actual item type and tool-use virtuals: type89, use20, or type87 ->
"Untitled"; otherwise native item-name helperc65450. Untitled is encoded as the
little-endian immediate64656c7469746e55 in instructionsb945b0 andb9460b, not a
RIP-referenced literal. Missing artifact -> "an unknown artifact". General
LPAGE:ARTIFACT/BOOK clauses do not execute for flags0. Item-name vocabulary and
virtual field boundaries are already maintained in mission-report-sources.tsv,
item-info-title-sources.tsv, item-raw-title-sources.tsv, src/legends_books.inc and
src/native_history_items.inc; generated names use the shared name translation.

HistoricalFigureName b92f10, default context72080, trailing int16 1 and1:
HF lookup67dc0. Missing HF -> "an unknown creature". A named HF uses its typed
language_name(+38), species/caste IDs(+2/+4), ghost/zombie flags and native
identity/nickname fields as required by the general formatter. Unnamed figures
use the native race/caste name and a/the forms. Caller-default context has no
interrogation/person perspective and flags0; the helper's generic interrogator,
subject, first-person and LPAGE literal branches in the asm are not asserted to
execute for this title call. Species/caste strings come from RAW fields and
remain the shared typed translation boundary, not a hardcoded list of world
names. Existing full helper source and semantic capture are preserved in
mission-report-sources.tsv and src/history_names.inc.

Detail-header continuation
--------------------------
Spoils/tribute detail at1d06ce..1d077b copies the selected record through
screen+83d8. It truncates a temporary string when length >= interior_width-2;
for room >3 it replaces the last three characters with '.'. Header addst is
1d0776, classic1d0706. Translation must retain the complete stored caption
before this resize/ellipsis stage. Neither the ellipsis nor a clipped visible
prefix supplies name provenance. Mission detail similarly uses stored+28.

Dynamic text scope
------------------
These finite producer branches exhaust the title families and fixed wording in
this report list. Save-dependent squad names, entities, sites, figures,
artifacts, book titles, item descriptions and years are typed runtime fields;
enumerating only screenshot values would omit their actual source domains.
The associated complete existing structured name/item/history paths handle
those domains. No game process, UI operation, hot reload or additional test was
performed by this source extraction.
